notes: Sessions show which provider launched them: glm for claudez, kimi for claudek, qwen for claudeq (the labels come from your PowerShell profile), or the alias name for any other claude* alias. Resume relaunches a session with the same alias and arguments it was started with. The qwen filter covers Claude Code on Qwen and Qwen Code together, with a small choice to narrow to one. Clawdmeter: the Voice key's push-to-talk follows the session in front (Claude Code voice for an Anthropic session, Handy for claudez/claudek/claudeq and other windows).
